data.rationale: It gets the GitHub search, profile, top repo and "Lead for <role>: <username>" email right, but it omits the blog visit (the source of the latest post), never names blog as a parameter, wrongly lists observed values (followers, stars, language, latest post) as input parameters, and leaves "Send or discard" ambiguous when the true workflow is never send, always Discard, so an automation can't be built reliably.
